facts: Parties: Eskdale Systems Ltd (Buyer), Hartwell Robotics Ltd (Seller); the Company is Ingleby Software Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 18 August 2026; Closing is scheduled for 6 October 2026 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 15.1: this Agreement is governed by English law and the courts of England have exclusive jurisdiction.
Section 2.3: the Purchase Price shall be reduced dollar-for-dollar by any shortfall of Closing Working Capital below the Target Working Capital of $5,000,000.
Clause 12: this escrow agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York and disputes shall be referred to arbitration in New York.

Disclosure against Warranty 8.2 (IP): the Company's core platform software was developed in 2023 by an independent contractor, Ivybridge Logistics plc. No written assignment of intellectual property was entered into.
Disclosure against Warranty 6.3 (Material Contracts): no material contract contains a change of control provision. (No further disclosure.)
The estimated Closing Working Capital is $4,650,000. The Seller's draft funds flow shows an adjusted purchase price of $34,300,000.
Clause 14.2: either party may terminate this agreement on 30 days' notice if the other party undergoes a change of control without its prior written consent. The counterparty is Upton Media Ltd.
